text-guide-scoring-content.text:
* Lose points equal to number of cards remaining in hand

If in the bonus zone (5 or fewer cards in hand):
* Gain points equal to lowest-rank card in hand

text-guide-melds-content.text:
Type:						Example:
* Singles 					13♠
* Sets (any length)			5♣, 5♥
* Suited Runs (any length)	7♦, 8♦, 9♦

text-guide-specials-content.text:
Dragon: plays only as a single; beats any single, including wilds
Dog: passes the lead to any other player of your choice
Phoenix: acts as another wild card
Genie: gives you the initial lead; has a value of 1; grants wish
